scope: Enable a fail-closed, pre-ingest model barrier only for Feishu account zhongshu, the existing dedicated VideoFactory group, and agent video-factory.
root_cause: OpenClaw 2026.7.1 reaches automatic media understanding before the project ingest script. The supported interception surfaces are inbound_claim before agent routing and before_agent_run before model input.

expected_result.target_attachment: claimed by inbound_claim, deterministically ingested, synthetic deterministic reply returned, agent model not run
expected_result.target_attachment_failure: handled deterministic error or before_agent_run block; model call count remains zero
expected_result.non_target_agents_and_groups: plugin does not claim or block

gateway_restart_scope: one controlled restart only after offline tests, config validation, backup verification, no active sessions, no running ingestion, and no imminent Cron.
tests: offline hook registration and scope tests
claim exception and timeout fallback to before_agent_run
plugin discovery and post-restart Gateway/Agent/Binding/Cron regression
rollback: Restore the byte-identical timestamped openclaw.json backup, remove the new plugin from plugins.allow and plugins.entries by restoring that backup, remove only the four new plugin files and focused test, restart the Gateway once to restore the prior known-good configuration, and verify hashes plus 14 Agent/14 Binding baseline.
stop_conditions: active task, inbound event, ingest process, or imminent Cron before restart
any attachment path reaching a model in a focused test
unaffected_other_agents_proof: Compare pre/post agent ids and binding summaries (14 each), Cron summary, enabled-plugin ids excluding the one authorized addition, and prove the plugin returns no decision for non-video-factory agents or non-target groups.
